item.title: MTOTP: Wouldn't it be nice if you were the 2FA device?
item.description:
📝 S-box (Substitution Box) is a digit-remapping table that replaces each digit (0–9) with another digit to introduce non-linearity. It is derived deterministically from the secret key by writing down each digit the first time it appears in the key, then appending any missing digits (0–9) in order; the position is the input digit and the value is the output digit. Time: 2601171700 Key : 1234598760 ---------------- Result: 3835669460 Call this: C = 3835669460 Step 4 - Apply Sbox Substitution Replace each digit of C using the S‑box table.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/VBranimir/mTOTP/tree/develop
